Broadcasting handlers:
- `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:163`
- `APIV1Service.DeleteMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:585`
- update path via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:71`
- `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:126`
- reactions: `UpsertMemoReaction`/`DeleteMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:106,161`

Tests also call it: `store/test/user_test.go:82,106,113,175,228`, `store/test/user_delete_test.go:187,190`, `store/demo_seed_test.go:50,60`, `server/router/api/v1/test/user_resource_name_test.go:150,174,193`, `server/router/api/v1/test/user_service_delete_test.go:51,252,417,486`, `server/router/api/v1/test/user_service_email_username_test.go:142,168,196,222,241`.

**q22.** Dispatcher: `APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` (→ `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, `:47`), called from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`. Delivery package: `internal/webhook` (`webhook.PostAsync` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` → queue → `Post` at `:120`, using SSRF-guarded `safeClient`). Signing: HMAC-SHA256 over `msgID.timestamp.body` in the Standard Webhooks format — headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature: v1,<base64>`, key from a `whsec_<base64>` secret (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:136-149`, `resolveSigningKey` `:91`).

**q23.**
- SQL schema: `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:33` (also `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql`)
- Go store model: `store/memo.go:34`
- API proto message: `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:198` (`message Memo`); payload proto `proto/store/memo.proto`
- Generated frontend types: `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts:79`

**q24.**
1. `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:178` (`useCreateMemo` → `memoServiceClient.createMemo`, `:183`) — editor path also `web/src/components/MemoEditor/services/memoService.ts:120`
2. `web/src/connect.ts:185` (`memoServiceClient` over Connect transport, `:172`)
3. `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:21` (`CreateMemo`); Connect entry `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:306`
4. `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` (`APIV1Service.CreateMemo`, store call at `:115`)
5. `store/memo.go:109` (`Store.CreateMemo` → `driver.CreateMemo`, `:113`)
6. `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (`INSERT INTO memo ...`; also `store/db/postgres/memo.go`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go`)

**q25.** Engine: CEL (Google Common Expression Language, via `cel-go`) compiled by the memo filter engine in `internal/filter` — entry `filter.DefaultEngine()` in `internal/filter/engine.go`, schema `internal/filter/schema.go`, CEL→IR in `internal/filter/parser.go`, IR→SQL in `internal/filter/render.go`, store glue `internal/filter/helpers.go`. Mechanism: the handler passes the filter string into `store.FindMemo.Filters` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_filter.go`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:178+`), and each dialect driver calls `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.DialectSQLite|DialectPostgres|DialectMySQL, &where, &args)` (e.g. `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`), so the renderer emits a dialect-specific SQL fragment plus args (`?` vs `$n` placeholders, `LIKE` vs `ILIKE`, `json_extract`/`->>`/`JSON_CONTAINS`/`@>`) that is ANDed into the `WHERE` clause.

**q26.** `memo_relation` (both directions, `store/memo.go:142,145`), `attachment` (`store/memo.go:149-157`), `memo` — both the target row and any comment memos deleted first (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:567-580`, `store/memo.go:158`), and `memo_share` via the `ON DELETE CASCADE` FK (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:102-110`, `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:101-109`) — note SQLite opens with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`), so that cascade is not enforced there. `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but never deleted (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:544-549`).

**q27.** Mechanism: the built React app is compiled into `web/dist` and embedded into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*`, then served by Echo's static middleware with an SPA (`index.html`) fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:21` (`embeddedFiles`), `:42-60` (`Serve`, static middleware + `spaFallbackMiddleware`), invoked from `server/server.go:69` (`frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)`).

**q28.**
- `s3presign.Runner` — started in `server/server.go:150-169`: one immediate `RunOnce` at startup plus a `time.Ticker` loop every 12 hours (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26-40`), cancelled via context on shutdown.

That is the only background runner started. Notes:
- `server/runner/memopayload` is not a background runner despite living under `server/runner/` — it's called inline from the memo handlers (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`).
- Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (a full cron scheduler with parser, jobs, middleware — `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `parser.go`, `job.go`) is referenced nowhere outside its own package/tests; the server does not use it.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:148-172`, installed on the Connect transport at `web/src/connect.ts:172-176`. Tokens it manages: a short-lived JWT **access token** (sent as `Authorization: Bearer …`, stored/refreshed via `web/src/auth-state.ts`, with preflight refresh + reactive 401 retry, `web/src/connect.ts:119-146`) and a **refresh token** held in an HTTP-only cookie (`credentials: "include"`, `web/src/connect.ts:57-62`; refresh call via a separate interceptor-free transport, `:66-72`). Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go`, `server/auth/token.go`, `server/auth/extract.go`), used through `NewAuthorizer`/`NewAuthInterceptor` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:67,136` and `server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go`. It also validates Personal Access Tokens (`server/auth/authenticator.go:19-24`).

**q30.**
- memo created: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` (called `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`) → activity `memos.memo.created`
- memo updated: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` — `:20` (called `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:67`) → `memos.memo.updated`
- memo deleted: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` — `:25` (called `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:562`) → `memos.memo.deleted`
- comment created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` — `:30` (called `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:119`) → `memos.memo.comment.created`

The first three funnel through `APIV1Service.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`), whose worker goroutines call `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`) for the actual HTTP delivery.
